Topics covered in this PDF

BRL-102 (Introduction to Retail Marketing) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • The marketing mix, consumer decision-making, situational variables, types of selling, qualities of a sales person
  • Customer needs, the SPANCO sales process, retail promotion, advertising and its categories

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: attempt all questions, maximum marks 100, coverage all blocks, assignment code BRL-102/TMA/2026-27. Part A: short type questions. Part B: two essay type questions of 15 marks each

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
